name: CSV to JSON
summary: Convert CSV spreadsheets to JSON arrays of objects — locally in your browser.
description: Paste CSV with a header row to get a JSON array of objects. Quoted fields, commas inside quotes, and simple type inference (numbers, booleans, null) are supported.

faqs.question: Must the first row be headers?
faqs.answer: Yes for this tool. Each header becomes an object key.

faqs.question: How are numbers and booleans handled?
faqs.answer: Bare numbers become JSON numbers. true/false/null become booleans/null. Everything else stays a string.

faqs.question: Is my CSV uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
